interpretation: The actual Windows PowerShell fixture explicitly enumerated batches of 70 and 74, checked exactly 144 cases and completed all parity checks. Its synthetic legacy-root-array test observed nesting=true on this job. That is a present fixture counterexample, not recovery of the previous failed run's hidden batch count or exception. All original 144 report values and expected outcomes were preserved; one duplicate case label was renamed. The failed short gate is archived at b59459ac6ac6e17065f8719d6c70c74b56bc5c20.

Both platforms passed all 945 required tests with zero skips. Windows passed the isolated production-input verifier, all PowerShell checks, seven real ZIP/extraction modes including 14-member Stage0b, and existing owned IPv6 TEST_ONLY loopback mechanisms. These are overlapping scoped tests, not full-repository or genuine Stage0b runtime acceptance.

The new helper and child environment remain pure/mock-tested only. Actual CoInitializeEx, SHGetKnownFolderPath, same-user local-path validation and the new two-key child block have not run in this gate. The known-folder API is not a proven fix for historical error 203. Current caller environment, single CreateProcess, zero capabilities, inherited handles, identity/image/jobs, deadlines and cleanup acceptance remain unchanged.

The proposed future single variant would add only verified current-user LOCALAPPDATA to the existing child SystemRoot block, without changing the four-key caller block or inheriting arbitrary environment. No fallback, retry, new token or global environment mutation is permitted. A successful future variant would not prove unique causality or exclude caller, cache, order or OS-build effects.

Public schema 3 records bounded lookup, COM and release attempts/returns, exact child keyset and deadline facts, never the private known-folder path. Successful cleanup calls are call-return observations, not independent deallocation proof. HRESULT values use strict unsigned 32-bit projection. Original identity/pipe/EOF/exit/cleanup conjunctions remain required.

Linux tiny paused owned QEMU and hosted TEST_ONLY IPv6 loopback are auxiliary mechanisms, not Windows guest or Stage0b results. Main receiver echoed 45 frames, wrong-echo control returned one and was rejected; seven process owners and two receiver owners were cleaned. Production valid network CLI was not executed; existing invalid-CLI/profile-only controls remain distinct.

Original PSEC Stage0 and both earlier real Stage0b failures remain immutable. No IPC, network, proxy or product qualification follows. Any genuine guest variant requires a separate one-run decision after this audit; no automatic runtime is triggered.
